# BetterLogs

> A lightweight, zero-dependency logging library for TypeScript, Node.js, and browsers. Provides 24-bit TrueColor themes, child loggers, structured metadata, automatic PII redaction, rotating file logging, and built-in Discord/Slack/HTTP transports.

## Quick Summary for AI Agents & LLMs

- **Package**: `@anishsharma/betterlogs`
- **Installation**: `npm install @anishsharma/betterlogs`
- **Zero Dependencies**: Pure TypeScript, fast, and works seamlessly in Node.js, browsers, and Edge runtimes.
- **Drop-in Console Upgrade**: `log.patchConsole()` instantly upgrades all existing `console.log()` calls across an entire codebase to formatted, redacted, timestamped logs without modifying other files.

## Recommended Usage Patterns

### 1. Basic & CLI Levels
```ts
import log from '@anishsharma/betterlogs';

log.info('Application started');
log.ready('Server listening on http://localhost:3000');
log.start('Building client bundle...');
log.success('Database migration complete');
log.warn('Cache memory nearing threshold');
log.error(new Error('Database query timed out')); // Auto-formats stack traces
log.fatal('Unrecoverable panic');
log.debug('Debug payload', { userId: 42 });
log.trace('Trace detail');
```

### 2. Configuration & Themes
```ts
log.config({
  theme: 'dracula', // 'dark' | 'light' | 'neon' | 'minimal' | 'dracula' | 'nord' | 'catppuccin'
  level: 'debug',
  showTimestamp: true,
  showEmoji: true,
  mode: 'pretty', // 'pretty' | 'json'
  timestampFormat: '24h',
  redaction: { paths: ['password', 'token', 'authorization', '*.secret'] }
});
```

### 3. Child Loggers & Scoped Context
```ts
const apiLog = log.child({ label: 'API', meta: { service: 'gateway' } });
apiLog.info('Request processed', { duration: 25 });
```

### 4. Express / Node HTTP Middleware
```ts
import express from 'express';
import log from '@anishsharma/betterlogs';

const app = express();
app.use(log.httpMiddleware()); // Color-coded HTTP request logging with duration and status
```

### 5. Async Context Tracing
```ts
log.runWithContext({ requestId: 'req_123' }, async () => {
  log.info('Inside service'); // Automatically includes [req_123]
});
```

### 6. Transports (Discord, Slack, HTTP)
```ts
import { DiscordTransport, SlackTransport, HttpTransport } from '@anishsharma/betterlogs';

log.addTransport(new DiscordTransport({ webhookUrl: 'https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...' }));
log.addTransport(new SlackTransport({ webhookUrl: 'https://hooks.slack.com/services/...' }));
log.addTransport(new HttpTransport({ url: 'https://api.example.com/logs' }));

// Per-call override:
log.with({ discord: true }).success('Milestone reached');
log.with({ discord: false }).error('Local error only');
```

### 7. Banners & Boxes
```ts
log.box('Deployment Complete\nURL: https://myapp.com', { title: 'Release', borderStyle: 'rounded' });
```
